notes_for_editor: Mostly rests on Lighthouse Friends (secondary, which cites Donald Graham, Lights of the Inside Passage, and a 1959 Vancouver Sun report) plus heritage records and three Marine Branch reports. Keeper roster is LF's list as printed, including odd overlaps (Borgens 2005-2012 vs Rose 2006-2015) and no USLHS data (Canada). Record tower height 31.0 m disagrees with plaque 23 m (Wikipedia gives 23 m / 21.9 m); story uses 23 m. LF says first lit 'around January 1'; plaque gives 1 January 1921. Marine_ca report years: corpus labels 1922/1923 for volumes whose Sessional Papers are dated 1923/1924; story avoids naming fiscal years for those. Vargas death is treated sparingly (no method). The April 2025 keeper death is unnamed and from one outlet's quoting Coast Guard; CBC fetch timed out, CTV body not retrievable. Footnote 1 uses LF facts in own words; one short quote only. The record's registers list CRHP 11407 under 'Light Tower' (federal building) not tower height. Fact-check 2026-10-27: Anderson's initials differ (LF William P.; CRHP 12770 W. A.), now stated in text. Focal height 28 m (List of Lights) vs 29.5 m (CRHP 12770).
